evidence_snippets: Future reservation for up to 90 days (in calendar mode): to provision TPU resources for up to 90 days, for a specified time period.
For more information, see Request TPUs with future reservation in calendar mode .
TPU reservations: to request a future reservation for one year or longer .

supporting_pages.title: "IAM overview \_|\_ Identity and Access Management (IAM) \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: When an authenticated principal attempts to access a resource, IAM checks the resource's allow policy to determine whether the principal has the required permissions.
When someone tries to perform an action in Google Cloud—for example, create a VM instance or view a dataset—IAM first checks if they have the required permissions.
Often, permissions correspond one-to-one with REST API methods—for example, the resourcemanager.projects.list permission lets you list Resource Manager projects.
